_readable: Feed ranking parameters (Feed Ranking Contract). The formula is fixed and published: rankedScore = interactionVolume * voteRatioFactor * ageFactor. interactionVolume = votes*wVote + comments*wComment + reactions*wReaction. voteRatioFactor = 1 + ratio.weight * (ratio - 0.5) once voteVolume >= ratio.volumeFloor (below the floor the ratio stays neutral so a single vote cannot dominate). ageFactor = 2 ** (-ageHours / ageDecay.halfLifeHours). The ranked section only recomputes over posts whose latest activity falls inside window.days; the base timeline never re-sorts.
